title: Complementary base and fibre dimensions on Bertini charts
statement: Let k be a field, Y smooth over k, L invertible and s_0,...,s_r generating sections inducing an immersion Y -> P^r_k. For p:Z -> Y, the reduced singular scheme of [def-zl-bertini-universal-family], every y has an affine neighbourhood U and natural numbers d,n such that d+n <= r, dim U <= d and every scheme-theoretic fibre of p|_U has dimension <= n. Dimensions use [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], the sections use [def-weil-pbc-morphism-to-projective-space-by-sections] and the fibres use [def-pc-scheme-fibre].

source.place: Tag 0FD6, lemma-bertini: final paragraph: kernel has dimension equal to the number of coefficients minus the first-order rank, followed by the fibre-dimension estimate

proof.text: Take U,d and the surjective first-order maps with their closed fibre embeddings from the local first-order model.

For a surjection E:kappa^(r+1) -> kappa plus kappa^d, rank-nullity gives d+finrank(ker E)=r, including d=0 and zero kernel. The symmetric algebra of the dual of ker E is a polynomial algebra in finrank(ker E) variables by SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial. A field has ring dimension zero, so the polynomial dimension formula and spectrum identification give its topological dimension finrank(ker E). Closed embeddings cannot increase topological dimension.

A smooth scheme of relative dimension d over a field has dimension at most d (topologicalKrullDim_le_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension). Set n=r-d; rank-nullity gives d+n=r. Apply the closed-embedding bound in each fibre.

theorem bertini_singular_affine_fibre_charts
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [Smooth f]
    (L : Y.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (r : ℕ)
    (s : ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1)) → Γ(L, ⊤))
    (hgen : Epi (L.freeHomEquiv.symm (fun i ↦
      (SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv L) (Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection L (s i)))))
    [IsImmersion (ProjectiveSpace.homOfGeneratingSections (ULift.{u} (Fin (r + 1))) f L
      (fun i ↦ (SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv L)
        (Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection L (s i))) hgen)] :
    ∀ y : Y, ∃ U : Y.Opens, y ∈ U ∧ IsAffineOpen U ∧
      ∃ d n : ℕ, d + n ≤ r ∧ topologicalKrullDim U ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
        ∀ z : U, topologicalKrullDim ((bertiniSingularToSource f L s ∣_ U).fiber z) ≤
          (n : WithBot ℕ∞)
